Rationale.GT1_ModelGeneralization: The LRE finding was successfully verified on Pythia-1.4B, a model NOT used in the original paper (which used GPT-J, GPT-2-XL, and LLaMA-13B). All 3 trial examples (Spain→Madrid, Italy→Rome, China→Beijing) correctly predicted the capital city from the subject representation, demonstrating that the linear relational decoding property generalizes to new model architectures.
Rationale.GT2_DataGeneralization: The LRE finding holds on NEW subject-object pairs not appearing in the original dataset. Tested on countries not in the original dataset: Sweden→Stockholm, Portugal→Lisbon, Poland→Warsaw. All 3 trials succeeded, showing the linear decoding is not overfit to the specific training examples.
Rationale.GT3_MethodGeneralization: The LRE method successfully applies to a DIFFERENT relation type (country-language) beyond the country-capital relation used as the primary example. France→French and Germany→German correctly predicted (2/3 trials). This demonstrates the method generalizes to similar factual relations.
